title: The Quantum Orchard
author: Barış Kısır
premise: Quantum agronomist Dr. Aiko Tanaka grows crops in superposition — every harvest exists in every state until observed. When one of her orchard trees bears fruit from a state that should be impossible, Aiko must confront the orchard itself: it is not growing crops, it is growing the future, and something is pruning it.
